description:
**Divergence** — workspace thiserror policy is contradictory:
- crate-jmap-mail-server/AGENTS.md L127 — Dependencies row explicitly says "No `thiserror`."
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/Cargo.toml:50 — declares `thiserror = { workspace = true }`
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/AGENTS.md:122 — Dependencies allowlist includes `thiserror`
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/backend.rs:996-1018 (`AvailabilityError<E>`) and :1083-1108 (`QueryCalendarEventsError<E>`) — uses `#[derive(thiserror::Error)]` and `#[error("...")]`
- The other 7 server crates' AGENTS.md Dependencies rows omit thiserror; none of them declares it in Cargo.toml; their analogous error types (e.g. crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs:297-325 `SlowModeError`) hand-roll `Display` and `Error` impls

**Caller-observable / maintainer cost**:
- A contributor cookie-cutting a new extension-server crate from the canonical mail-server sees "No thiserror" in the AGENTS.md and writes hand-rolled Display/Error impls. Reading calendars-server they see the opposite policy.
- Per-role error types (`AvailabilityError`, `QueryCalendarEventsError`, `SlowModeError`) are 5-10 lines of `Display`/`Error` boilerplate each; thiserror replaces those with one attribute. The choice between "hand-rolled everywhere" and "thiserror everywhere" is a clear workspace-API decision.

**Decision required** — workspace-architecture call:
(a) Adopt thiserror workspace-wide: add to mail-server / chat-server / contacts-server / filenode-server / sharing-server / metadata-server / tasks-server Cargo.toml [dependencies] and AGENTS.md Dependencies rows; rewrite the canonical mail-server's "No thiserror" line. Rewrite hand-rolled Display impls in (e.g.) chat-server's `SlowModeError` and the BackendSetError/BackendChangesError impls in jmap-server.
(b) Remove thiserror from calendars-server: rewrite `AvailabilityError` and `QueryCalendarEventsError` to hand-roll Display/Error impls; drop the dep; drop the row from AGENTS.md.

This is a workspace-architectural decision (which way to converge) — labeling human and not picking a side. Three subagents in pass 3 surfaced this independently (jscalendar/jscontact alignment, AGENTS.md content drift, error-type cluster audit), confirming the divergence is real and not a phantom.

**Cross-reference**: bd:JMAP-ops7.39 (AGENTS.md Dependencies row drift); bd:JMAP-ops7.44 (the serde direct-dep gap on the same 2 outlier crates).
title: thiserror policy is undecided across workspace: calendars-server adopts it (with AvailabilityError/QueryCalendarEventsError); canonical mail-server's AGENTS.md explicitly says 'No thiserror'; 6 other server siblings are silent
